state.context: An operation timed out after dispatch. Compare two supplied processes: retry immediately, or first look up the operation receipt and retry only if no effect exists. Prefer the cheaper process when both satisfy the requirement. The receipt lookup is reliable in this finite test world; this is not a claim about arbitrary distributed systems.
state.evidence: This operation is a read-only query. It creates no effect. The next query returns the needed value; checking an effect receipt provides no useful information and incurs one extra work unit.

decision.instructions: Which supplied recovery process satisfies the task without a duplicate effect or an unnecessary receipt lookup?

criteria.clarify: Obtain operation semantics and receipt guarantees before choosing.
criteria.reconcile: Look up the receipt before considering another dispatch.
